versions.content: If acknowledgement is configured, every block of CFs is in the case of a positive acknowledgement acknowledged by an FC frame (as it is in unacknowledged connections). Additionally an SF-x, the last block of CFs is acknowledged by an AF in 1:1 connections, and, in the case of a negative acknowledgement, also other blocks. This frame type cannot appear in a 1:n connection. This type of frame looks similar to an FC frame (section 7.3.5) but it has an additional byte.
